mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% for two consecutive months indicates weak labor market conditions that suppress corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0%, or Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates strong monetary support for consumption, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with strong consumer credit
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS declines and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 during late-cycle expansion signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC for INDPRO in late-cycle is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 130,000 consistently signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 130,000, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 550,000 units signals weak residential construction activity, indicating economic slowdown and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 550.0, or Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) combined with low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates monetary policy response to labor market weakness, preceding negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 0.5% during monetary tightening cycles signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, pressuring equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in tightening cycles is below 0.02.
